summary: João Pedro is out until about the New Year. Emegha, who scored on his first start against Leeds, is widely predicted to lead the line at Forest, with Palmer in the No 10 role. That puts more pressure on Estêvão's place.

claims.text: Alonso: not ready to train with the squad; 'we need to see game by game how he's feeling'.
claims.source_name: The False 9, João Pedro injury update

claims.text: Alonso: out for at least a few more weeks, now targeting a New Year comeback.
